entities.summary: Daniel Taylor Vogelbach is an American professional baseball coach and former first baseman and designated hitter who is currently an assistant hitting coach for the Milwaukee Brewers of Major League Baseball (MLB). Vogelbach played in MLB from 2016 to 2024 for the Seattle Mariners, Toronto Blue Jays, Brewers, Pittsburgh Pirates, and New York Mets.
